Maximum likelihood estimator (MLE)

estimate_beta_mle.Rd

Estimates \(\theta = (\beta, \sigma)\) and the parameters \(\gamma\) of the Weibull AFT model for \(X | Z\) (model_xz) together, by maximizing the observed-data likelihood. For a censored row, the likelihood integrates \(f_{Y|X,Z} f_{X|Z}\) over \(x > W\) with a 64-node Gauss-Legendre rule. The MLE estimates \(\gamma\) together with \(\theta\) because the estimating equations for \(\gamma\) involve \(\theta\) through \(f_{Y|X,Z}\); fitting the model for \(X | Z\) to \((W, D, Z)\) alone first, as the two-step MLE does, gives a biased estimator under outcome-dependent censoring. The MLE does not use a model for \(C | (Y, Z)\); model_weights is used only for the starting values. The MLE is consistent when \(f_{Y|X,Z}\), including its normal errors, and \(f_{X|Z}\) are correctly specified.

Usage

estimate_beta_mle(
  data_yXZ,
  model,
  model_xz = NULL,
  model_weights = NULL,
  aw_var = "AW",
  a_var = "A",
  maxit = 5000
)

Arguments

data_yXZ

A data frame with one row per subject. It must contain the outcome, the covariates in model, the age a_var, the observed W = min(X, C), and the indicator D = I(X <= C).

model

A formula for the outcome model, y ~ AW + Z1 + ..., with the time-to-event covariate aw_var on the right-hand side. The outcome model is \(Y = \beta_0 + \beta_{A-X} (A - X) + \beta_Z' Z + \epsilon\), \(\epsilon \sim N(0, \sigma^2)\).

model_xz

A one-sided formula for the Weibull AFT model of \(X | Z\), for example ~ Z. Defaults to the covariates of model other than aw_var.

model_weights

A one-sided formula for the Weibull AFT model of \(C | (Y, Z)\), for example ~ y + Z. Defaults to the outcome and the covariates of model other than aw_var.

aw_var

Name of the column A - W in model. Defaults to "AW".

a_var

Name of the age column A. Defaults to "A".

maxit

Maximum number of Nelder-Mead iterations (followed by BFGS).

Value

A list with

beta_est

Estimates of \((\beta, \sigma)\).

se_est

Sandwich standard errors.

gamma_est

Estimated coefficients and scale of the Weibull AFT model for \(X | Z\).

gamma_se

Their sandwich standard errors.

convergence

Convergence code from optim (0 = converged).

loglik

Maximized log-likelihood.

Examples

set.seed(1)
dat <- data_aft(500)
estimate_beta_mle(dat, y ~ AW + Z, model_xz = ~ Z)
#> $beta_est
#> (Intercept)          AW           Z       sigma 
#>   0.9579996   1.0202631   1.0221674   1.0277029 
#> 
#> $se_est
#> (Intercept)          AW           Z       sigma 
#>  0.06570011  0.04194453  0.04974389  0.03588711 
#> 
#> $gamma_est
#> (Intercept)           Z       scale 
#>  0.09482263  0.11804817  0.46886206 
#> 
#> $gamma_se
#> (Intercept)           Z       scale 
#>  0.03448112  0.03093776  0.02352981 
#> 
#> $convergence
#> [1] 0
#> 
#> $loglik
#> [1] -912.6282
#>
